name: Raj
source:
[i]“Stay away from me.”[/i]

Rude, hot-headed and hard to predict. He always keeps his distance from people. Only Ji has a chance to reach him. After all, they were once best friends.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3965050/]Steam[/url]]
